tagline.en: FramePack — a low-memory, image-to-video approach designed to keep long-video generation within modest VRAM.
tagline.zh: FramePack——一种低显存的图生视频方案，旨在让长视频生成保持在有限显存内。

en: FramePack, from lllyasviel, is an image-to-video model with a focus on long-form output under tight memory budgets. Its core idea is to compress and pack frame context so that generating a longer clip doesn't blow up VRAM the way a naive approach would.

It ships image-to-video checkpoints built on the HunyuanVideo backbone, including an F1 variant. In WorldFoundry, FramePack runs through a minimal infer-only runtime vendored in-tree: give it a source image and a prompt, and it generates a video through the shared pipeline.
Weights are downloaded separately. The Hugging Face repositories are public and non-gated, but they don't declare an explicit license, so review the upstream terms before redistribution.
zh: FramePack 由 lllyasviel 推出，是一款专注于在紧张显存预算下生成长视频的图生视频模型。其核心思路是压缩并打包帧上下文，使生成较长片段时不会像朴素做法那样显存暴涨。
它提供基于 HunyuanVideo 主干构建的图生视频 checkpoint，包括一个 F1 变体。在 WorldFoundry 中，FramePack 通过内置的极简仅推理运行时运行：给它一张源图和提示词，它便经由统一 pipeline 生成视频。
权重需单独下载。其 Hugging Face 仓库公开且非门控，但未声明明确许可，再分发前请查阅上游条款。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want to animate an image into a longer clip on limited hardware — FramePack is built to keep memory use manageable as the video grows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在有限硬件上把一张图像扩展成较长片段时很合适——FramePack 的设计目标就是让显存占用随视频变长仍可控。

notFor.en: The Hugging Face repos don't expose an explicit license, so check the upstream terms before redistribution. Weights are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 其 Hugging Face 仓库未提供明确许可，再分发前请核对上游条款。权重需单独下载。
